landing.title: A clear CV and a short email, built from what you've really done.
landing.lead: Paste a job, and get a CV and application email in your own words, formatted the way employers expect where you're applying.

truth.title: Nothing invented
truth.body: Every line comes from facts you entered or confirmed. If a job asks for something you haven't shown, we ask you instead of guessing.

region.title: Right for the country
region.body: Photo or no photo, date of birth, page length, paper size and spelling adjust to where you're applying. You can change any of it.

private.title: Your data stays yours
private.body: Never sold, never shared, never used to train AI. Export or delete everything whenever you like.

postingCheck.titleFound: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} worth double-checking
postingCheck.leadFound: These aren't proof of anything; real jobs can trip them too. They're questions worth answering before you share personal details.
postingCheck.leadNone: That's a good sign, not a guarantee. Do your usual checks before sharing personal details.
postingCheck.tip1: Find the job on the company's own careers page, reached from a search, not from a link in the message.
postingCheck.tip2: Real employers don't charge you to apply, train or get a visa.
postingCheck.tip3: Don't share bank details or ID documents until you have a written offer you've verified.
postingCheck.tip4: If something feels rushed or too good to be true, it's fine to slow down and ask questions.

asks_payment.title: Asks you to pay
asks_payment.ask: Ask what the fee is for and whether it's in writing. Real employers don't charge candidates.

bank_or_id.title: Asks for bank or ID details
bank_or_id.ask: These are only needed after a verified written offer. Ask why they're needed now.

untraceable_payment.title: Mentions crypto, gift cards or wire transfers
untraceable_payment.ask: These payments can't be reversed. Ask why a normal payroll or company account isn't used.

personal_email.title: Recruiter uses a personal email
personal_email.ask: Check the person on the company's website or LinkedIn, and reply to a company address if you can.

chat_only.title: Contact only by chat app
chat_only.ask: Ask for a call or an email from a company domain. Interviews held only by text chat are unusual.

unrealistic_pay.title: Pay sounds unusually high or easy
unrealistic_pay.ask: Compare with similar roles. Ask how pay is calculated and what the hours are.

guarantees.title: Guarantees a job or visa
guarantees.ask: No one can guarantee selection without an interview. Ask what the process actually is.

urgency.title: Pushes you to hurry
urgency.ask: Pressure to act fast is a common tactic. It's fine to take a day and check.

unnamed_company.title: The company isn't clearly named
unnamed_company.ask: Ask who the employer is. Agencies sometimes keep it quiet, but you should know before sharing details.
